data.title: Who is behind El Reno’s Bitcoin mining facility? News 4 investigates
data.description: As El Reno officials say they have reached out to the owners of the Bitcoin mining facility at the center of the city’s massive water leak, rumors continue to swirl about who those owners actually are...
